scope: Real isolated Chrome; desktop/mobile UI and public-file downloads only, not physical validation.
assertions: Desktop 1440x1100 renders the exact 149-part mm scene without audio or automatic motion
Reduced-motion and idle camera produce a stable rendered canvas
All 52 threaded components on all three axes have correct IDs, joints and public mate IDs
Reference counterpart navigation and unresolved motor torque remain explicitly labelled
Keyboard explode reaches 100%, section clipping is active, and section position changes in mm
Reset restores composition, axis, selection, explode, section, filter and highlight defaults
A real 3D raycast click on the visible frame screw opens its J01 card
Keyboard camera orbit, zoom and Home operate on the actual Three camera
All geometry bounds fit the viewport in single/reference-three modes at 0/50/100% without a per-frame camera override
Both native/STEP compositions and curated ZIP downloaded through real browser UI with matching SHA-256
Real Chrome accessibility tree labels all controls; keyboard skip-link and visible focus are present
Touch-capable 390x844 viewport has no horizontal overflow, stacked layout, selection, explode, section and reset
Missing mesh produces a visible HTTP 404 explanation; retry succeeds once the file is restored
Tampered or mixed-version mesh is rejected with a visible SHA-256 error
An explicitly paused CAD release disables download actions and shows the reason while 3D remains inspectable
A missing local 3D engine is caught by bootstrap rather than leaving a blank canvas
Opening file:// shows an explicit local-HTTP instruction without attempting model fetches
Both root and Pages-style subpath work; preview does not serve .git or local build scripts
